# unlinked.ai

> AI-powered LinkedIn network search over your own uploaded archive, available through the open-beta app.

Public Start and Sign in links lead to the working open-beta app at https://private.unlinked.ai/login.
Sign in or create an account through Ideaflow ID; no invitation is needed.
Prefer a full LinkedIn ZIP; Connections-only is also supported.
Upload and ask AI about your own network, then open Agent setup in the beta app for its MCP configuration.
The app currently runs separately from the www.unlinked.ai homepage; this is an interim bridge.
Legacy API schemas below are historical reference documentation, not the beta onboarding or MCP setup path.

## Documentation
- [Agent setup status](/agents): sign-in bridge and instructions for Agent setup in the beta app
- [Developer notes for agents](/AGENTS.md): agent-readable brief on authentication, server-side scoping guarantees, and REST API endpoints
- [Well-known product descriptor](/.well-known/unlinked.json): machine-readable bootstrap manifest
- [MCP server card](/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Model Context Protocol server card for `@unlinked/mcp-server`
- [OpenAPI specification](/openapi.json): full OpenAPI 3.1.0 schema for agent-facing HTTP routes

## Machine Access Reference
- Base URL: `https://www.unlinked.ai`
- Availability: Open-beta sign-in, upload, own-network AI search and Agent setup are at https://private.unlinked.ai/login. Legacy API availability remains separate.
- Historical Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer ul_<key>` header on legacy agent requests.
- Historical Key Format: Keys start with prefix `ul_`; no live key creation URL is advertised.
- Scoping Guarantee: Agent API requests are scoped to the caller; see /AGENTS.md for details.
- Note on Backend: Interface documentation reflects supported schemas and tools; database availability follows backend plan state.

## HTTP Endpoints
- `GET /api/me`: Return authenticated caller's own profile, plus connection and upload counts.
- `POST /api/search-contacts`: Semantic search restricted to direct connections; returns matches with similarity score and reasoning. Request body: `{"query": string, "limit"?: number}` (limit 1-25, default 10).
- `GET /api/profiles/{id}`: Look up a profile by UUID. Readable only for caller's own profile or a direct connection; unrelated profiles return 404.
- `POST /api/draft-intro`: Draft a short, forwardable intro message between the caller and a direct connection. Read-only (nothing is written). Request body: `{"contactProfileId": string, "context"?: string}`.
- `GET /api/imports`: List caller's uploaded LinkedIn archives and total ingested record counts across their network graph.

## MCP Tools
The `@unlinked/mcp-server` package preserves the historical stdio tools for MCP-aware clients. Live setup is unavailable until private access reopens; the tool roster is reference documentation:
- `unlinked_me`: Return the caller's own unlinked.ai profile plus connection and upload counts.
- `unlinked_search_contacts(query, limit?)`: Semantic search over direct connections (max 25 results) with match scores and explanations.
- `unlinked_get_profile(profileId)`: Read own profile or direct connection's profile (unrelated returns not-found).
- `unlinked_list_imports`: Return LinkedIn archive uploads and ingested-record counts.
- `unlinked_draft_intro(contactProfileId, context?)`: Draft a short, forwardable intro to a direct connection.
